refresh_policy.notes: Treat Argo as an operational ocean-observing network snapshot with open access routes and mission expansion pages, not as a single lightweight browser-side feed.

use_guidance.primary_role: Use for oxygen, pH, ocean-state, and marine-profile support on hypoxia, deoxygenation, fisheries, and ocean carbon uptake nodes.
use_guidance.caution: Argo data access is distributed across GDAC mirrors and network tools. This bundle should steer users toward official network access points rather than imply one universal JSON endpoint.

overview.title: Argo ocean observing support
overview.description: Argo is an international program that collects information from inside the ocean using a fleet of robotic instruments that drift with the ocean currents and move up and down between the surface and a mid-water level.
overview.gdac_summary: Official GDAC access covers float metadata, trajectory, profile, and technical data through mirrored HTTP, FTP, web-service, and selection-tool routes.
overview.bgc_summary: BGC Argo extends the network with pH, oxygen, nitrate, chlorophyll, particle, and irradiance sensors to support ocean acidification, hypoxia, and carbon-uptake observation.
